reason: The Self-Consistency abstract explicitly calls it a decoding strategy that selects the answer "by marginalizing out the sampled reasoning paths" (paths discarded, no training), and the STaR abstract explicitly says it will "fine-tune on all the rationales that ultimately yielded correct answers" (training on generated reasoning paths); the only imprecision is "majority-voted," since STaR filters rationales by ground-truth correctness rather than majority vote.
